newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Easyknit places 82.5 mln new shares.
newsitem.headline: Easyknit places 82.5 mln new shares.

text.p: Easyknit International Holdings Ltd said on Monday its controlling shareholder Magical Profits Ltd would subscribe 82.5 million new shares to raise about HK$61.47 million after expenses.

The company said Magical Profits will place 82.5 million existing shares to five independent investors at HK$0.75 per share before it subscribed the same amount of new shares at net placing price after expenses.
Easyknit said the shareholding of Magical Profits, which is owned by its chairman Koon Wing Yee, would be diluted to 50 percent on completion of the deals on May 9, from 52.86 percent.
The company said the net proceeds of HK$61.47 million raised from the subscription would be used to fund part of its HK$68 million purchase of a shop in Kowloon's Tsim Sha Tsui district.
